title: Oscar and the Alibi
author: Rafael Joubert
blurb: Vesper Almeida, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
